settings.fallback_text: That's completely fine — most people don't know the part names. Choose the option below, describe where it goes in your own words, and attach photos to our reply. Our team identifies it for you.

settings.title: Lost your assembly instructions?
settings.body: Ask us and we'll email the assembly guide for your exact model. Include your order number if you have it.

settings.s1_sub: Choose your product to see common parts and send a request for the correct replacement.
settings.no_model_note: Not sure which one you have? Choose the closest match — we confirm it from your photos anyway.
settings.s2_sub: Select the area of your product where the issue or missing part is.
settings.locked_msg: Choose your product above to open the parts diagram.
settings.other_desc: Can't see it in this list — describe it below and send photos
settings.area_note: These are common parts linked to the selected product. We'll confirm the exact fit before sending a replacement; a part number is optional.
settings.s3_sub: This decides whether your request is handled as a warranty replacement or a paid part.
settings.issue_list:
A part was missing from the package | It was on the parts list but not in the box
A part arrived damaged | Bent, cracked or scratched on arrival
A part broke after installation | Failed during or after assembly
I lost a part | Misplaced during or after assembly
I need extra hardware | More screws, bolts or connectors
I'm not sure | We'll work it out from your photos
settings.photo_note: Photos settle almost every claim in one reply. After you submit we'll email you — attach one photo of the whole product and one close-up of the problem to that reply.
settings.s4_sub: Your order number lets us check what actually shipped, which speeds up a warranty replacement.
settings.submit_note: No payment is taken now. Our support team reviews your request, confirms the exact part, then ships it under warranty or sends you a quote.
settings.success_msg: Thanks — we've received your request and will reply within 1–2 business days.
settings.g_sub: Need the instructions for your model? Include the product and order number in your request.
